messages:
noah_b: FYI incoming SI + hardware marketplace submission for Polar Freight. Need quick decision on lead ownership, SFDC mapping, and ROE before we publish. Can partnerships triage?
tanya_s: On it. Quick check: is Polar already in SFDC? region and estimated ARR?
omar_r: Polar is EMEA, POC active, estimated ARR ~30k, not in an open opportunity.
noah_b: Proposed rule: POC <100k -> partner-led intake by default; POC >=100k or existing contract -> Redwood-led. Need partner to claim within 48h or it flips to Redwood.
jen_mktg: 48h SLA sounds reasonable. Also require single SI rep and single HW contact before listing. We've seen multiple contacts stall approvals.
omar_r: I'll create a temporary SFDC account tag if there's no exact match: tag marketplace:intake + partner:ArcticSI + hw:QuantumEdge. That way we avoid dupes.
marketplace-bot: New listing submitted: https://redwood.app/listings/PolarFreight-2026 
metadata: partner=ArcticSI, hw=QuantumEdge, sku=qedge-lt.
noah_b: Good. Credit split needs to be set before intro. Recommend default 65/35 (SI/Redwood) for POCs under 100k, subject to KAM review. @olivia_kam can you take point?
olivia_kam: Got it. I'll review and post within 24h. If SI is driving pipeline heavily we can increase partner share.
tanya_s: Action items: 1) Omar create temp SFDC record if needed (omar_r) 2) Noah draft intro template (noah_b) 3) Olivia review credit split (olivia_kam) 4) Marketplace hold publish until claim confirmed (jen_mktg)
omar_r: Temp account created: SFDC-TMP-1127, tagged and linked.
jen_mktg: Holding listing until claim. Adding form checkbox: "SI acknowledges joint ordering with Redwood" to prevent orphan SKUs.
oah_b: Drafting intro now, will post here and cc: ArcticSI + QuantumEdge + Polar procurement. Plan to ask for procurement contact and pilot start date.
olivia_kam: Note: require SI to confirm they won't invoice marketplace SKU without Redwood on order. Also cc KAM in intro.
noah_b: Thanks. Aim to have claim + intro out within 24-48h. If no claim, flip to Redwood-claim and notify KAM. Closing when intro sent. :white_check_mark:
